title: Nad's For Men Down Under Hair Removal Cream 150mL
detail_text: Nad’s For Men Down Under Hair Removal Cream is designed specifically for the removal of male body hair in the genital or pubic area. Ready to use and fast acting, Nad’s For Men Down Under Hair Removal Cream with soothing Aloe, removes unwanted hair quickly and painlessly to leave a smooth finish. The benefits of clearing body hair from your private parts extend way beyond aesthetics. Simply apply liberally around the genital area, wait around 4 minutes and shower clean. • Designed specifically for use on intimate body parts • Gentle on sensitive areas, but tough enough to remove short, coarse hairs • Painless, fast and effective • Removes hair in as quickly as 4 minutes • Formulated with Aloe Vera to help soothe and protect the skin • Grooming made easy and convenient in the comfort of your own home Active ingredients: Aqua (Water), Cetearyl alcohol, Potassium thioglycolate, Urea, Dimethicone, Isopropyl myristate, Glycerin, Ceteareth-20, Calcium hydroxide, Glyceryl stearate, Parfum (Fragrance), Prunus amygdalus dulcis (Sweet Almond) oil, Acrylates copolymer, Tocopheryl acetate (Vitamin E), Aloe barbadensis leaf juice powder, Limonene, Linalool. Directions: On clean, dry skin, apply cream generously to the pubic area, groin area, perineum and scrotum, in this order. Using your hand, smooth cream on to completely cover hair with a thick and even layer is applied, making sure each hair strand is completely covered by the cream Do not rub in. Wash hands immediately with soap and water. Leave cream on for at least 4 minutes. Using a soft cloth, test a small area for hair removal. If hair does not come away easily, leave the cream on for a few minutes without exceeding 6 additional minutes. Wipe cream and hair away with a damp cloth in the shower. Rinse treated area thoroughly with water, ensuring all traces of cream have been removed, and gently dry the skin. Ensure cream is wiped from tube tip and cap is properly sealed after each use. Contraindications and cautions: • Keep out of reach of children. • External Use Only. • Poison - DO NOT swallow or ingest. If swallowed, DO NOT induce vomiting. • Irritant. Repeated exposure may cause sensitisation. • Suitable for use on male intimate areas including the groin, pubis, perineum and scrotum only. It is not suitable for use on the penis shaft, glans, anus, face, eyes, head or inside the ears or nose. • Please note that it is important to do a patch test on a small part of the genital area. If no adverse reaction, then Nad’s For Men Down Under Hair Removal Cream can be applied further. • Do not leave on skin for longer than 10 minutes. Wash hands after use. Contains alkali and thioglycolate. Prolonged or incorrect exposure may result in burns. • Do not use on sunburnt, broken, inflamed or irritated skin, over warts, pimples, scars, moles or wounds or if you have suffered an adverse reaction to hair removal creams in the past. • Store below 30°C in a dry place away from direct sunlight. • If you experience any tingling or burning sensation during use, remove the cream immediately and rinse thoroughly with water. If this sensation persists, seek medical advice. • Wait at least 24 hours after use before sunbathing or using any perfumed product or astringent lotion. • Always allow for at least 72 hours between hair removal sessions. • Avoid contact with jewellery as discolouring may occur. • Product may cause surfaces to become slippery. Ensure cream is rinsed thoroughly from shower surfaces. • If in eyes, hold eyelids apart and flush the eye continuously with running water. Continue flushing for at least 15 minutes and seek medical advice from a doctor. • If unwanted skin or hair contact occurs, remove contaminated clothing and flush skin and hair with running water. This product may not be right for you. Always read the label, warnings and instructions for use, before purchase. Made in Australia
detail_html:
Nad’s For Men Down Under Hair Removal Cream is designed specifically for the removal of male body hair in the genital or pubic area. Ready to use and fast acting,

Nad’s For Men Down Under Hair Removal Cream with soothing Aloe, removes unwanted hair quickly and painlessly to leave a smooth finish. The benefits of clearing body hair from your private parts extend way beyond aesthetics. Simply apply liberally around the genital area, wait around 4 minutes and shower clean.

• Designed specifically for use on intimate body parts
• Gentle on sensitive areas, but tough enough to remove short, coarse hairs
• Painless, fast and effective
• Removes hair in as quickly as 4 minutes
• Formulated with Aloe Vera to help soothe and protect the skin
• Grooming made easy and convenient in the comfort of your own home

Active ingredients:
Aqua (Water), Cetearyl alcohol, Potassium thioglycolate, Urea, Dimethicone, Isopropyl myristate, Glycerin, Ceteareth-20, Calcium hydroxide, Glyceryl stearate, Parfum (Fragrance), Prunus amygdalus dulcis (Sweet Almond) oil, Acrylates copolymer, Tocopheryl acetate (Vitamin E), Aloe barbadensis leaf juice powder, Limonene, Linalool.

Directions:

  1. On clean, dry skin, apply cream generously to the pubic area, groin area, perineum and scrotum, in this order. Using your hand, smooth cream on to completely cover hair with a thick and even layer is applied, making sure each hair strand is completely covered by the cream Do not rub in. Wash hands immediately with soap and water.
  2. Leave cream on for at least 4 minutes.
  3. Using a soft cloth, test a small area for hair removal. If hair does not come away easily, leave the cream on for a few minutes without exceeding 6 additional minutes.
  4. Wipe cream and hair away with a damp cloth in the shower. Rinse treated area thoroughly with water, ensuring all traces of cream have been removed, and gently dry the skin.

Ensure cream is wiped from tube tip and cap is properly sealed after each use.

Contraindications and cautions:
• Keep out of reach of children.
• External Use Only.
• Poison - DO NOT swallow or ingest. If swallowed, DO NOT induce vomiting.
• Irritant. Repeated exposure may cause sensitisation.
• Suitable for use on male intimate areas including the groin, pubis, perineum and scrotum only. It is not suitable for use on the penis shaft, glans, anus, face, eyes, head or inside the ears or nose.
• Please note that it is important to do a patch test on a small part of the genital area. If no adverse reaction, then Nad’s For Men Down Under Hair Removal Cream can be applied further.
• Do not leave on skin for longer than 10 minutes. Wash hands after use. Contains alkali and thioglycolate. Prolonged or incorrect exposure may result in burns.
• Do not use on sunburnt, broken, inflamed or irritated skin, over warts, pimples, scars, moles or wounds or if you have suffered an adverse reaction to hair removal creams in the past.
• Store below 30°C in a dry place away from direct sunlight.
• If you experience any tingling or burning sensation during use, remove the cream immediately and rinse thoroughly with water. If this sensation persists, seek medical advice.
• Wait at least 24 hours after use before sunbathing or using any perfumed product or astringent lotion.
• Always allow for at least 72 hours between hair removal sessions.
• Avoid contact with jewellery as discolouring may occur.
• Product may cause surfaces to become slippery. Ensure cream is rinsed thoroughly from shower surfaces.
• If in eyes, hold eyelids apart and flush the eye continuously with running water. Continue flushing for at least 15 minutes and seek medical advice from a doctor.
• If unwanted skin or hair contact occurs, remove contaminated clothing and flush skin and hair with running water.

This product may not be right for you. Always read the label, warnings and instructions for use, before purchase.

Made in Australia

User-friendly Formula Designed with a user-friendly formula, it ensures a gentle yet effective hair removal experience. Versatile Use Ideal for removing hair from underarms, private parts, legs, and bikini area, catering to both men and women. Discreet Application The discreet application process allows for easy use at home or on-the-go, making it convenient for daily use. Efficient Root Removal The cream effectively removes hair from the root, preventing regrowth and providing a clean, bare look.

title: Pozitilan | Men's Hair Removal Cream for Private Parts, Face, Beard, Armpit, Hands, and Legs
detail_text: Suitable for Men Specifically formulated for men, this depilatory cream is gentle on the skin yet effective in removing hair. Easy Application The cream is easy to apply, providing a convenient and hassle-free hair removal experience at home. Permanent Results With regular use, this depilatory cream can achieve permanent hair removal, offering long-lasting results and saving time on frequent hair removal sessions. Effective Hair Removal The cream is highly effective in removing hair from sensitive areas such as the face, armpits, and legs, ensuring a smooth and hair-free skin.
detail_html:
Suitable for Men

Specifically formulated for men, this depilatory cream is gentle on the skin yet effective in removing hair.

Easy Application

The cream is easy to apply, providing a convenient and hassle-free hair removal experience at home.

Permanent Results

With regular use, this depilatory cream can achieve permanent hair removal, offering long-lasting results and saving time on frequent hair removal sessions.

Effective Hair Removal

The cream is highly effective in removing hair from sensitive areas such as the face, armpits, and legs, ensuring a smooth and hair-free skin.

What Is a Roll-On? A roll-on is a cartridge that contains soft wax, the same that you get in wax cans. It is fully made in hard plastic and one of its main pieces is the head, which is a plastic cap that helps close the cartridge and spread the wax evenly. The plastic on the roll-on does not get too hot, so the cartridge can be handled simply with gloves. The head of the roll-on comes sealed for security and hygiene.Roll-on cartridges have a standard content of 3.9 fl oz (100 ml) How to Warm Up a Roll-On Wax Cartridge Roll-ons are really easy to use and easy to warm up. The professional and recommended way to heat up a cartridge is with a roll-on heater applicator since these devices are specially designed to melt the wax inside the cartridge evenly and steadily, providing the right consistency for application. Heater applicators are special devices that can hold one roll-on cartridge. The inner part of the device is lined with metal sheets which conduct heat to the wax. The device comes with a cord that plugs directly to a power outlet. How To Use a Roll-On Wax Cartridge Once your roll-on is melted, it's time to start waxing. : AC110-250V/50-60Hz

Roll-on cartridges make hair removal a lot easier since they are mess-free and don't need the use of a traditional Wax Heater.

What Is a Roll-On?

A roll-on is a cartridge that contains soft wax, the same that you get in wax cans.

It is fully made in hard plastic and one of its main pieces is the head, which is a plastic cap that helps close the cartridge and spread the wax evenly. The plastic on the roll-on does not get too hot, so the cartridge can be handled simply with gloves. The head of the roll-on comes sealed for security and hygiene.Roll-on cartridges have a standard content of 3.9 fl oz (100 ml)
How to Warm Up a Roll-On Wax Cartridge

Roll-ons are really easy to use and easy to warm up. The professional and recommended way to heat up a cartridge is with a roll-on heater applicator since these devices are specially designed to melt the wax inside the cartridge evenly and steadily, providing the right consistency for application.

Heater applicators are special devices that can hold one roll-on cartridge. The inner part of the device is lined with metal sheets which conduct heat to the wax. The device comes with a cord that plugs directly to a power outlet.
How To Use a Roll-On Wax Cartridge
Once your roll-on is melted, it's time to start waxing.
Besides the cartridge, you'll need a few other elements, namely waxing strips, pre-depilatory lotion, powder, and a post-depilatory lotion.

Apply the wax directly from the roller onto the skin (hold the cartridge at a 45-degree angle on the area you want to wax and press gently while moving the cartridge along about 35 cm. Do this motion in a single swipe so that the wax will come out evenly in a thin film. Now you are ready to press the waxing strip on the wax in the direction of hair growth and removing it against, all while keeping the skin taut.

Roll-on waxing is quick and mess-free for either the professionals or waxers at home. Why not give it a try?
